arguments.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for getting in touch. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer has visited and quoted for a replacement part (an expansion vessel). Because of the cost, your landlord has asked for a second quote, and Swift P&H are due to visit on 14 October. Once we have that, the landlord can decide and we can book the repair. I can't promise a repair date yet, but we'll keep you updated. In the meantime, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water completely, or see any leaks, tell us straight away and we'll treat it as urgent. If you smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999. On bins: we don't run collections, so please check with Tower Hamlets Council (their website has a missed collection form). Sorry we can't help more on that one.

answers.answer: No. The boiler issue is already covered by open ticket R-4799, and the bin issue is not a maintenance matter.
